frame.name: Frame 244
frame.note: Direct children of Frame 244 in Figma child order. z ascending = painted later = on top. Coordinates are frame-local as reported by Figma (get_node already returns frame-local; no page offset was subtracted). This is the authoritative z-order; frame244-layout.json is sorted by y and does NOT carry it. 'section' is derived from the direct child's top y, not verified against a render.
